title: Shared Assessments Standardized Information Gathering (SIG) Questionnaire
version: SIG 2026 confirmed on issuer product page (mappings list 'Shared Assessments SCA 2026'); a 'Product Release 2027' was reported by a search snippet of the issuer homepage but could not be confirmed directly
applicability: Customer convention, not law. Financial-institution-affiliated DAF sponsors and their parent banks or broker-dealers commonly run third-party risk programs on SIG Lite or SIG Core, so Unbound should expect SIG-derived questionnaires during onboarding. Echelon is not obliged to license SIG to answer a customer's SIG; the customer holds the license. Echelon should map its canonical questions to SIG domains by identifier only. Applicability to Echelon as a vendor: likely (customer-driven). Applicability as a certification: none; SIG is not a certification.
license: Licensed product. Issuer page lists a paid annual corporate license (USD 7,000 per year shown 2026-11-25) or access through membership. SIG content is proprietary and may not be copied or redistributed; Echelon must not reproduce SIG question text in this repository and may cite SIG domain or question identifiers only (operating contract rule 5).
limitations: Issuer pages other than the SIG Excel page redirect to a Microsoft Entra sign-in for automated clients, so release notes, current release year and license agreement text could not be read. SIG states it maps to ISO 27001/27002:2022, ISO 27701, ISO 42001, NIST 800-53, NIST CSF 2.0, NIST 800-171r3, PCI DSS 4.0, CIS v8, DORA, GLBA-related FFIEC booklets and others; mapping quality was not evaluated.
notes: Open question: confirm whether SIG 2027 has been released and what changed (AI, supply chain).

verification.method: Fetched issuer SIG Excel page (version list, mappings, price) 2026-11-25; other issuer pages blocked by SSO redirect; current release year (2026 versus 2027) not confirmed; publication date unknown.

title: STAR Level 1: Security Questionnaire (CAIQ v4.1)
applicability: Customer convention and self-assessment vehicle. Many SaaS buyers accept a completed CAIQ in lieu of a custom questionnaire. For Unbound, a public CAIQ (optionally a STAR Level 1 registry listing) is a low-cost transparency artifact, but it is a self-attestation (first-party) and must reflect the honest proposed-target-state posture. Applicability: optional, likely useful.
license: CSA research publications: free download; per CSA website terms, publications may be used, copied and printed but not modified or translated without CSA consent, must keep notices, and commercial use of CCM/CAIQ inside products or consulting requires a CSA license (CCM page: license not needed for internal use). Echelon may answer a CAIQ and reference question IDs; embedding CAIQ text in a commercial product or service requires a license.
limitations: Yes/No format with comments; answers are self-asserted. Seed title said v4; current version is 4.1. Release date shown is the date on the CSA artifact page.
notes: Version correction: seed referenced v4; CAIQ v4.1 released 2026-01-27 per CSA.

verification.method: Fetched CSA artifact pages for CAIQ v4.1 and CCM/CAIQ v4.1 and CSA website terms 2026-11-25.
